description.to:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

Entry criteria: M4; PPY-966722 for threat-intelligence.anth.us.
Exit criteria for the M7 path: rehearsal PPY-e1d26f and cut-over PPY-e51189 done, TI's operations moved (PPY-0c4b55). Exit for closing this milestone: 14 days green (PPY-16f13a); M7 does not wait for it (decision D3).
Customer-visible: TI readers: no visible change (URL parity). TI editors: the shared newsroom host.
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: None.
Contains: PPY-e1d26f, PPY-966722, PPY-e51189, PPY-0c4b55, PPY-16f13a, PPY-32b4c5
Follows: M4.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
Scenario: The staging tenant matches the live TI site (features_backend/ti-shared-rehearsal.feature, PPY-e1d26f)
Scenario: The copy is complete (same file)
Scenario: A verified custom domain serves the tenant (features_backend/custom-domain.feature, PPY-966722)
Scenario: A bad cut-over can be reversed without losing edits (features_backend/ti-cutover.feature, PPY-e51189)
Scenario: TI's monitor delivers into the shared stack after cut-over (features_backend/ti-operations-move.feature, PPY-0c4b55)
Scenario: TI is served from the shared stack (PPY-32b4c5)
Scenario: TI's old backend is retired only after the green period (features_backend/ti-shared-done.feature, PPY-16f13a)

Acceptance checks:
1. Every TI URL from the old sitemap answers the same status and content hash (allowing the tenant marker) from the shared stack.
2. Final copy's second run changes nothing; adoption report shows zero tenant-less rows.
3. Rollback rehearsed on staging (alias switch back plus copy-back of new edits) before cut-over day; Ryan approved the cut-over day.
